name: Viking Technology
old_description: Memory and Storage Solutions Optimized for Military Applications
about:
Viking Technology operates from a technology facility in Costa Mesa, California. The company has been delivering leading-edge design and engineering development in DRAM memory, Flash storage, and micro-packaging technologies for over two decades. No founding year or founders are disclosed in public materials.

The firm designs and manufactures ruggedized memory and storage solutions, including DDR4 multi-chip package modules, 2 TB M.2 PCIe NVMe drives, and persistent memory with integrated supercapacitors. Its capabilities span advanced testing in a clean room environment with 110 GHz validation, conformal coating, anti-sulfur resistor integration, and custom form-factor miniaturization. Production occurs at an ITAR-compliant, AS9100-certified U.S. facility, though headcount and floor space are not published.

Viking serves defense and aerospace programs, including ground, sea, and air platforms, as well as avionics and cockpit instrumentation. It also supplies automotive-grade memory rated for -40 °C to +105 °C, telecommunications infrastructure, and energy subsystem applications. Customers range from military prime contractors to industrial OEMs requiring extended temperature ranges from -55 °C to +125 °C.

The company emphasizes U.S.-based R&D, development, and production, coupled with long-standing strategic partnerships and comprehensive supply-chain management. Security features such as hardware AES 256-bit encryption, NSA 9-12 compliant write protection, and hardware-triggered quick erase are built into its military-optimized products.
